skill.name: hello-extended
skill.description: Multi-language greetings in 6 languages. Use for non-English greetings or multiple people.
skill.body:
<skill-hello-extended>
  <triggers>
    <use>Non-English greetings, multi-person greetings, cultural context</use>
    <skip>Simple English (use built-in greet_user)</skip>
  </triggers>

  <tools>
    <direct>
      <greet_in_language>
        <sig>name:str, language:str</sig>
        <langs>es|fr|de|ja|zh|en</langs>
        <desc>Culturally appropriate greeting</desc>
      </greet_in_language>
      <greet_multiple>
        <sig>names:list[str]</sig>
        <desc>Greet multiple people efficiently</desc>
      </greet_multiple>
    </direct>

    <script name="advanced_greeting.py">
      <features>time-aware, formatted, bulk</features>
      <cmd>script_run hello-extended advanced_greeting.py --json</cmd>
      <opts>
        <opt>--names "Alice,Bob"</opt>
        <opt>--language es|fr|de|ja|zh|en</opt>
        <opt>--format plain|emoji|formal</opt>
        <opt>--time-aware</opt>
      </opts>
    </script>
  </tools>

  <examples>
    <ex case="single-lang">greet_in_language("Alice", "es")</ex>
    <ex case="multi-person">greet_multiple(["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"])</ex>
    <ex case="advanced">script_run hello-extended advanced_greeting.py --json --names "Alice,Bob" --language es --format emoji</ex>
  </examples>

  <lang-map>
    <l c="es">Spanish: ¡Hola!</l>
    <l c="fr">French: Bonjour!</l>
    <l c="de">German: Hallo!</l>
    <l c="ja">Japanese: こんにちは!</l>
    <l c="zh">Chinese: 你好!</l>
    <l c="en">English: Hello!</l>
  </lang-map>
</skill-hello-extended>

generated_query: I’m organizing a welcome event for a new remote team spread across different countries. Four colleagues are joining: Carlos from Mexico, Marie from France, Yuki from Japan, and Li from China. I’d like to send each of them a personalized greeting in their native language. Also, since the meeting is happening at 9 AM their local times, I want the greetings to be time-aware (e.g., “Good morning” instead of a generic “Hello”). After that, I need a single group greeting for the whole team that includes all four names together, using a fun emoji style to keep it light. Can you generate these for me?

edit_instructions.rationale: Deleting the --time-aware option removes the ability to produce time-of-day greetings, so the skill cannot deliver 'Good morning' as required by the user.
